items.exampleEn: This phone comes in many color options.
items.exampleZh: 這款手機有很多顏色可以選。

items.exampleEn: The two companies have good relations.
The next two days are critical for our business.
items.exampleZh: 接下來兩天對我們的生意非常關鍵。

items.exampleEn: My parents are concerned about my long working hours.
items.exampleZh: 我爸媽擔心我工作時間太長。

items.exampleEn: My grandfather can still recall his first day at school.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺還記得他上學的第一天。

items.exampleEn: The concept of time is different in every culture.
items.exampleZh: 每個文化對時間的概念都不一樣。

items.exampleEn: There is a possibility that the flight will be late.

items.sentenceEn: Do you recall the name of that restaurant?
items.sentenceZh: 你記得那家餐廳的名字嗎？

items.audioEn: I'm concerned that we don't have enough chairs for the party.
items.audioZh: 我擔心我們派對的椅子不夠。

items.sentenceEn: Leaving early is not an option today.
The teacher explained the concept with a simple picture.
items.sentenceZh: 老師用一張簡單的圖解釋這個概念。

items.stemEn: Is there any ____ that the shop will open on Sunday?
items.stemZh: 這家店星期天有可能開嗎？

items.stemEn: Good sleep is ____ for children's growth.
items.stemZh: 充足的睡眠對孩子的成長非常關鍵。

items.passageEn: Ms. Lu runs a small language school. She is concerned that many students forget new words quickly. She believes the first week of learning a word is critical. One option she tried was to define each new word simply and then show a real object. Another was to show the relation between new words and old ones. Her students now remember words much better, and their test results have improved steadily. She can even recall the day one shy student said a whole sentence. Now she sees the possibility of opening a second school.
items.passageZh: 呂老師經營一間小型語言學校。她擔心很多學生很快就忘了新單字。她認為學一個字的第一週非常關鍵。她試過的一個方法，是先簡單定義每個新字，再拿出真實的物品給學生看；另一個方法是讓學生看出新字和舊字之間的關聯。她的學生現在記單字記得好多了，考試成績也穩定進步。她甚至還記得有個害羞的學生第一次說出完整句子的那一天。現在，她看到了開第二間學校的可能性。

options: 學生人數比去年少很多
學費比別家還要貴很多

questions.questionZh: 呂老師現在看到什麼可能性？

referenceEn: I don't recall what his name is.
rubricZh: recall 表示「想起、記起」，後面直接接受詞
「想不起來」可寫 can't recall、don't recall 等
寫 can't remember 意思也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 option 造一個句子，說說你上班或上學有哪些交通選擇。
referenceEn: I have two options: I can take the train or ride my bike.
Taking the bus is the cheapest option for me.
rubricZh: option 表示「選擇、選項」，是可數名詞，兩個以上用 options
可用 the best option、the cheapest option 等說法
說的是自己的情況（例如 I、me）
